dct_description_sm:
Notes on browsing:

Click on the "Tree" view to identify folder structure and related files.

The dataset contains colour images of lakebed sites sampled in Lake Erie and Lake Ontario from a top down view. A pixel-wise segmentation label is provided for each image to indicate the presence of Dreissenid mussels. The data are organized into three sets: for training, validating, and testing machine learning models.
